g.text: Concordance permutation tests — Δ correlation, Z-norm / Pearson / Union-1K

Bars sit on the attainable values k/n; the statistic is discrete. Line = KDE, scaled to the measured lattice. Shaded tail = the one-sided permutation p-value (10,000 permutations), greyed where p≥0.05 so colour does not outrun the evidence.

The cell shuffle (c, f) is the primary test: it rebuilds pseudobulk and the whole correlation matrix from randomised perturbation identity. Panel a’s null reaches only even counts because concordant = 2a−18 under a fixed 46/37 label split.
